newsHighlights.title: China-Russia-US summit positive, constructive, fruitful: Xi
newsHighlights.summary: President Xi Jinping said the China-Russia-US summit has been positive, constructive and fruitful while summarizing the main consensus reached at the talks.
newsHighlights.translation: 习近平主席在总结会谈达成的主要共识时表示，中俄美峰会是积极的、建设性的、富有成果的。

newsHighlights.title: Xi meets Trump, calling for continued efforts to steer China-US relations on right course
newsHighlights.summary: Xi urged both sides to make continued efforts to steer China-US relations along the right course.
newsHighlights.translation: 习近平呼吁双方继续努力，引领中美关系沿着正确方向前行。

newsHighlights.title: Xi makes four points on how major countries should get along with each other
newsHighlights.summary: Xi put forward four points on how major countries should get along with one another, stressing mutual respect and win-win cooperation.
newsHighlights.translation: 习近平就大国如何相处提出四点主张，强调相互尊重与合作共赢。

newsHighlights.title: Three postcards, one journey of opportunity in Shenzhen
newsHighlights.summary: Following three postmarks, a China Daily reporter set out to find their senders in Shenzhen and discovered a journey of opportunity and friendship.
newsHighlights.translation: 《中国日报》记者循着三张明信片的邮戳，在深圳寻找寄信人，开启了一段充满机遇与友谊的旅程。

newsHighlights.title: Xi's speech boosts confidence in Asia-Pacific cooperation
newsHighlights.summary: Xi's keynote speech at the APEC CEO Summit 2026 boosted confidence in Asia-Pacific economic cooperation and drew wide applause from business leaders.
newsHighlights.translation: 习近平在2026年APEC工商领导人峰会的主旨演讲增强了亚太经济合作的信心，赢得商界领袖广泛赞誉。

quote.quote: The single biggest problem in communication is the illusion that it has taken place.
quote.author: George Bernard Shaw
quote.translation: 沟通中最大的问题是人们误以为沟通已经发生了。
quote.explanation: 很多时候我们以为自己已经说清楚了，其实对方并没有接收到关键信息。真正的沟通需要确认、倾听和反馈——正如峰会前各方反复确认共识，职场中也应主动复述与核实，避免'自以为沟通成功'。

vocabulary.example: President Xi said the China-Russia-US summit has been positive, constructive and fruitful.
vocabulary.translation: 习主席表示，中俄美峰会是积极的、建设性的、富有成果的。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻标题 "China-Russia-US summit positive, constructive, fruitful: Xi"，指三国元首举行的最高级别会谈。

vocabulary.translation: 双方就如何保持关系沿正确方向前行进行了建设性对话。

vocabulary.translation: 习近平在总结会谈达成的主要共识时发表了上述讲话。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻摘要 "summarizing the main consensus reached at the talks"，指会谈各方达成的一致意见。

vocabulary.translation: 会议被形容为富有成果，签署了多项协议。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 "the China-Russia-US summit has been positive, constructive and fruitful"，强调会谈收获颇丰。

vocabulary.example: China has worked hard to promote economic cooperation across the Asia-Pacific region.

vocabulary.example: Trump arrived at the Shenzhen venue for talks with Xi.
vocabulary.translation: 特朗普抵达深圳会场，与习近平举行会谈。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 CGTN 新闻 "Watch: Trump arrives at Shenzhen venue for talks with Xi"。

vocabulary.example: Xi called for further efforts to build an Asia-Pacific community through open dialogue.
vocabulary.translation: 习近平呼吁通过开放对话进一步推动构建亚太共同体。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 CGTN 新闻 "Xi calls for further efforts to build Asia-Pacific community"，强调以对话促进合作。

pattern.pattern: call for / urge continued efforts to do sth.（呼吁/敦促继续努力做某事）
pattern.example: Xi called for continued efforts to steer China-US relations on the right course.
pattern.translation: 习近平呼吁继续努力，引领中美关系沿正确方向前行。
pattern.usage: 常用于职场与外交沟通中表达'持续推进'的建议。结构：主语 + call for / urge + (continued) efforts + to do sth.。也可换成 make continued efforts to do sth.（主语为行动方）。例：Our manager urged continued efforts to improve team communication.（经理敦促大家继续努力改善团队沟通。）

grammar.title: 并列形容词的表达：A, B and C（评价性排比）
grammar.explanation: 在总结会议、评价表现或给出反馈时，英语常用两到三个褒义形容词并列（逗号隔开，最后一个用 and 连接），使评价更有力、更正式。注意：形容词之间不用 and 连接前几项，顺序一般从抽象到具体、音节由短到长，读起来节奏感更好。职场中常用于绩效评估、会议总结和项目复盘。
examples: President Xi Jinping said that the China-Russia-US summit has been positive, constructive and fruitful.
The APEC CEO Summit was described as open, pragmatic and forward-looking.

pronunciation.tips: 重音在第二个音节 /ˈstrʌk/。首音节弱读为 /kən/，不要读成 /ˈkɒn/。中间 /str/ 辅音连缀要一口气滑过，/k/ 短促有力，最后 /tɪv/ 轻快收尾。对比记忆：construct /kənˈstrʌkt/ → constructive /kənˈstrʌktɪv/，重音不变。
examples: Both sides held a constructive dialogue during the summit.
We welcome any constructive suggestions on this project.

reading.title: What the Shenzhen Summit Teaches Us About Workplace Communication
reading.content: At the APEC meeting in Shenzhen, leaders from China, Russia and the United States held a summit that President Xi Jinping described as positive, constructive and fruitful. Observers say the habits behind such talks work just as well in the office. First, the parties chose a neutral venue and met face to face. Second, each side stated its position in plain language before inviting a response. Third, they focused on the consensus they had reached instead of the points where they disagreed. Finally, they called for continued efforts to keep relations on the right course. For anyone leading a team or closing a deal, the lesson is simple: honest dialogue, careful listening and a shared goal can turn a difficult conversation into a journey of opportunity — much like the three postcards that led a reporter to new friends in Shenzhen.
reading.translation: 在深圳举行的APEC会议上，中俄美三国领导人举行了峰会，习近平主席形容其为积极的、建设性的、富有成果的。观察人士认为，这类会谈背后的习惯在办公室里同样适用。第一，各方选择中立场地，面对面交流。第二，各方先用平实的语言陈述立场，再邀请对方回应。第三，他们聚焦已达成的共识，而非彼此的分歧。最后，双方呼吁继续努力，让关系保持在正确轨道上。对于任何带团队或谈合作的人来说，道理很简单：坦诚的对话、用心的倾听和共同的目标，能把一次艰难的谈话变成一段充满机遇的旅程——就像三张明信片引领一位记者在深圳结识新朋友那样。
reading.sourceNote: 本文基于 China Daily 与 CGTN 于2026年11月20日发布的APEC深圳峰会系列报道改写，用于英语学习目的。
